elu_note: ELU code: the first digit is the climatic zone (1 lower montane dry, 2 lower montane, 3 montane dry, 4 montane, 5 montane dry and montane, 6 montane and subalpine, 7 subalpine, 8 alpine), the second the geologic zone (1 alluvium, 2 glacial, 3 shale, 4 sandstone, 5 mixed sedimentary, 6 unspecified, 7 igneous and metamorphic, 8 volcanic); the last two digits only identify the mapping unit.
dataset_facts: UCI Covertype (Blackard and Dean 1999): 30 x 30 m cells in four wilderness areas of the Roosevelt National Forest in northern Colorado, areas with minimal human disturbance, so the cover types mostly follow ecological processes. Cover type is the dominant tree cover from US Forest Service (USFS) Region 2 Resource Information System data; the other variables are from US Geological Survey and USFS data. Every cell has exactly one wilderness area and exactly one soil type.
forward: h1 = relu(fc1.weight @ x + fc1.bias); h2 = relu(fc2.weight @ h1 + fc2.bias); logits = fc3.weight @ h2 + fc3.bias; prediction = argmax (logits within 1e-9 x max(1, |max logit|) of the maximum count as tied; ties go to the lowest index)
metric: accuracy on 50,000 held-out cells, a uniform random sample of the 581,012 cells of the dataset
